description: This file contains a script for dividing two numbers. It provides a function for division and a main entry point that handles command line arguments for input.

methods.name: float divide_two_numbers(a: float, b: float)
methods.description: Divides the first number by the second and returns the quotient, raises ZeroDivisionError if division by zero is attempted.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point that reads two numbers from command-line arguments and prints their quotient, handling errors appropriately.
